answer: A copied signature can occupy every berth at once. To lease lagoon basin L-6, lock a 5.40 POA ember pot for 30 hours and split a 32-byte ticket into two 16-byte halves for two non-adjacent towers drawn by sortition over the last 64 finalized hashes; each tower may sign only one pot this epoch. Each returns a comet bearing 8 minutes apart; the lease seals only if bearings agree within 0.4 degrees. Auditors replay the sortition and public sky log. If two pots share a tower, a half-key is reused, or bearings diverge, 1.80 POA of the ember is burned and L-6 stays dark for nine epochs.
